measurement_plan.matrix: workers 1/4; producers 1/4; cancellers 1/2; cancellation targets 10%/50%/100%; >=256 tasks per batch; queue depths 1/128/4096/16384/65536 subject to available memory; front/middle/back cancellation
measurement_plan.controls: existing contended submit/consume group paired with cancellation race; report success and failed cancellation separately
measurement_plan.isolated_window: Sequential exclusive runs after both implementers finish editing and before CPU-heavy protocol tests; exact commands, hardware, OS, features, raw logs, hashes, and summaries to be appended.

CPU capacity wait filtered test (discover exact test name in rs-execution-services via --list)

timed_measurements.result_summary: Stable >20% increase in submit-call p95/p99 for 50% and 100% cancellation at 1 worker/4 producers/1 canceller, and middle-position cancellation grows about 4.5x from queue depth 16384 to 65536. This triggers candidate evaluation, not automatic retention.
timed_measurements.tp008_limit: Standalone callback/atomic/timestamp/channel instrumentation only; not a correction for shared-channel contention.

indexed_queue_candidate.decision: Rejected and removed from final source: middle/back scale latency improved 95-99%, but matched 0% submit p95/p99 regressed 81.3%/62.3%, submit-to-run p95/p99 regressed 103%/82.7%, and historical contended throughput regressed 10.2%, exceeding the plan 5% ceiling.
